hook: → 观点卡：Nvidia出口管制风险与算力循环融资脆弱性
lines: The host notes that the confirmation of Blackwell chips in Chinese data centers strips away Nvidia's plausible deniability regarding U.S. export controls and threatens its high-margin trajectory.
The discussion highlights systemic fragility in the AI sector due to the 'Bank of Jensen' model, where circular financing and close ties among hyperscalers echo pre-2008 financial vulnerabilities.
Experts argue that tightening U.S. restrictions are accelerating the technological gap between American frontier labs and Chinese counterparts.
The podcast warns that AI is rapidly evolving from a retrieval tool into a scientific engine capable of breakthrough work in fields like materials science and cryptography.
title: Nvidia’s Undoing?, China’s AI Decline, Alexandr Wang’s Superintelligence Warning
